purpose: Check run, the first real run: download and verify the pinned llama-server archive and the four local model files of the main run (a-0p5b, a-1p5b, a-4b, b-2b), start each on a shared 4-vCPU GitHub-hosted runner, warm it up and time three requests per E3 workload at concurrency 1. It proves the pins before the smoke run; its timings are this runner's, not site hardware's.
